study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the Heterogeneous Phenotype of Schizophrenia and Bipolar Disorder Using Normative Models

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Thematically Organized Psychosis (TOP) study MRI cohort from Oslo, Norway.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "This study used cross-sectional, T1-weighted magnetic resonance imaging data from participants recruited for the Thematically Organized Psychosis study..."

answer.TOP: Normative model training/validation in healthy controls; applied to schizophrenia and bipolar disorder patients for deviation mapping.

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Normative range estimated in healthy individuals with 10-fold cross-validation; model trained on all data then applied to patients.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "we estimated the normative range for this model in healthy individuals under 10-fold cross-validation, then applied the model trained on all data to patients."

model-2.model-name: FreeSurfer cortical thickness and pial area normative model

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Healthy individuals n=256 used to estimate normative range; same cohort used for VBM and FreeSurfer analyses.
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "Healthy  Individuals  (n = 256)"; "we estimated the normative range for this model in healthy individuals under 10-fold cross-validation"

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Healthy individuals age mean (SD) 34 (9.5) years, range 18-59.

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: Healthy individuals male 140 (54.7%); female inferred as 256-140=116 (45.3%).
